method.advancement: Require at least four additional fresh edit locations across three works and both generators, no more than two additional fresh original works, and at least 36 of 40 edits assessed. Adding this check cannot affect authorship confidence.
method.decision: Require complete measurement of all interior sentences. The highest untied interior sentence above that arm's locked ordinary-work maximum point gives one exact location.
method.holdout: Use twenty GAO reports with matching original excerpts and one exact labeled edit from each of two generators. Exclude works appearing in earlier published writing ledgers and normalized 12-word overlap with earlier eligible source works or retained comparison shards.
method.input: Read the target sentence by itself and with its exact two native neighbors. Use the same fixed typed question with both orders of the two labeled choices and average the AI responses. Do not score truncated input.
method.point: Freeze a separate point per input using the second-highest maximum across 35 earlier dated authentic journal revision works, after requiring at least 30 measurable calibration works. Reconstruct the exact 70 source excerpts using prior published hashes and measure the candidate from scratch.
method.validation: Measure both arms against the incumbent native three-sentence context response at its unchanged .50 operating point. Keep the first six incumbent ranges. A successful span intersects at least half of the edited nonwhitespace characters and achieves .30 nonwhitespace intersection over union.
